crustu.dialog_1: Wood is one of the most useful resources you can find. It can be used to build, craft, and even fuel a good fire.
crustu.dialog_2: While everyone is enjoying the festival, the trees are still standing, waiting for someone with a good axe.
crustu.dialog_3: Every tree has its value. Some provide better wood than others, so choose carefully where you cut.
crustu.dialog_4: Just remember one thing: you can cut down many trees, but none of them will grow back overnight.

cubris.default\n:
Hello!
I can plant the seeds you have, but it will cost 1 bronze coin per seed.
Each seed will take 1 hour to harvest.
You will only be able to harvest when you have grown all the seeds.
cubris.default:
Planting will 1 bronze coin per seed.
Each seed will take 1 hour to harvest.
You will only be able to harvest when you have grown all the seeds.
cubris.dialog_1: If you plan to grow something, you`ll need to start with a seed. With patience and a little care, even the smallest one can become something valuable.
cubris.dialog_2: The TORGOTES festival has brought people from everywhere, but plants keep growing at their own pace. I don`t think nature cares much about festivals.
cubris.dialog_3: The TORGOTES festival has brought people from everywhere, but plants keep growing at their own pace. I don`t think nature cares much about festivals.
cubris.dialog_4: Never underestimate a small seed. Many of the greatest things in this world started exactly that way.

druigar.default:
Welcome to the bank.
Here you can store your items to free up inventory space.
You can access the items using any of your characters.
Accessing your account is free.
Withdrawing and depositing items costs {{npcs.bank.cost}} gold coins.
druigar.dialog_1: I see you`re just beginning your adventure. If you find anything valuable along the way, you can leave it with me. My bank is the safest place to keep your belongings.
druigar.dialog_2: Ah, the TORGOTES festival... Every year, this town gets noisier on October 31st. And every year, someone ends up losing something.
druigar.dialog_3: Warriors arrive, wizards appear, merchants sell all sorts of things... but there`s always someone who leaves carrying much more than they brought.
druigar.dialog_4: Keep your belongings safe. An adventure may begin with a simple festival... and no one knows where it might end.
druigar.item_received: You have received items from your bank account. Talk to Druigar to get them.

fresale.dialog_1: Fabric may seem delicate, but it`s essential for many things. Clothes, accessories, and all kinds of creations begin with good material.
fresale.dialog_2: With so many people dressed up for the festival, there`s no shortage of fabric around town. Some went all out and barely look like themselves.
fresale.dialog_3: The secret to good work lies in the quality of the material. Poor fabric can ruin even the finest creation.
fresale.dialog_4: A piece of fabric may not seem like much, but in the right hands, it can become something completely different.

grevanni.customize: Select the items you want to customize. Changes to your character"s appearance will cost: {{npc.customize.cost}}
grevanni.customize_buy:
Select the customizations you want to purchase.
The value is paid with diamonds.
grevanni.default: Welcome! You would like to take advantage of discounts on jewelry?
grevanni.dialog_1: Amulets and rings are not mere ornaments. Some protect, others strengthen... and some seem to know things that we don`t.
grevanni.dialog_2: The TORGOTES festival always attracts people from all over. It`s the perfect night to find rare things... and even rarer people.
grevanni.dialog_3: Curiously, my amulets have been reacting strangely. Perhaps it`s just the magic of Halloween... or perhaps not.
grevanni.dialog_4: Magic tends to whisper before it screams. The problem is that almost no one pays attention to the whispers.

greysli.default: Want to add a special touch to your look?
greysli.dialog_1: You came to the festival looking like that? On Halloween, you can be whoever you want.
greysli.dialog_2: Warrior, wizard, archer, monster... it doesn`t matter! On Halloween, no one needs to ask who you really are.
greysli.dialog_3: And if someone asks who you are... just make up a story. After all, isn`t that what Halloween is all about?
greysli.dialog_4: Enjoy it while you can. A good costume may last one night... but a good story can last forever.

kalhassi.default: Don`t insist. The entrance is closed.
kalhassi.dialog_1: The entrance to Padixa is under my watch.
kalhassi.dialog_2: Party or not, my job remains keeping this entrance secure.
kalhassi.dialog_3: I`ve seen all kinds of adventurers pass through these gates. Some came looking for fame, others for riches... and some simply never returned.
kalhassi.dialog_4: I know the festival makes many people curious, but the city will remain closed until further notice.

pedaspa.default: Would you like to try a new look?
pedaspa.dialog_1: It doesn`t matter if you`re a warrior, wizard, or archer. Before any adventure, there`s one thing only you can choose: who you want to be.
pedaspa.dialog_2: On Halloween, it`s a perfect night to try a new look. A different hair color, new eyes... perhaps even a completely different appearance?
pedaspa.dialog_3: It`s curious how small changes can completely transform the way someone is seen. Sometimes, all it takes is changing the color of your eyes or hair to look like a different person.
pedaspa.dialog_4: You can change your appearance as many times as you want. Just don`t try to change who you are... that`s usually much harder.

purcilus.dialog_1: A sword, a bow, or a staff... it doesn`t matter which you choose. Every great adventure begins with the right weapon in hand.
purcilus.dialog_2: At the party, we have music, food, and fights! I hope no one forgets that some of these fights are just for fun.
purcilus.dialog_3: They say the best stories begin when a game stops being a game. I hope that doesn`t happen around here.
purcilus.dialog_4: Choose your weapon carefully. It may not make you a hero, but it certainly helps you survive long enough to try.

safur.default:
I can get water from the well for you.
But you will need 1 empty container.
safur.dialog_1: If you plan to travel, work, or fight, you`d better remember to bring some.
safur.dialog_2: In the middle of all this celebration, it`s easy to forget about the most important things. Food, rest, and water are still necessary, even during a festival.
safur.dialog_3: The well is here for everyone, but water shouldn`t be wasted. Take only what you need and remember to come back when it runs out.
safur.dialog_4: Some people only realize the value of water when they run out of it. It`s better not to wait until then.

sergales.dialog_1: If you`re looking for protection, you`ve come to the right place. A good piece of armor can be the difference between telling an adventure story and becoming part of one.
sergales.dialog_2: Just look at how many warriors came to the festival! Everyone seems ready for a grand battle.
sergales.dialog_3: I`ve never understood why so many people leave their real armor at home when everyone is dressed to look like adventurers.
sergales.dialog_4: Armor doesn`t have to be beautiful. It has to work. But if you can have both, even better.

ysifur.default: Talk to me whenever you need to recover health or mana. It`s free for you!
ysifur.dialog_1: Ah, finally, someone who looks like they could use a real potion! I have remedies for wounds, mana, and almost any problem an adventure can bring.
ysifur.dialog_2: On Halloween, even the greatest heroes deserve to have a little fun before going back to fighting monsters.
ysifur.dialog_3: My cauldrons have been restless since early this morning... The liquid won`t stop bubbling, even after I put out the fire. Strange, don`t you think?
ysifur.dialog_4: If you`re planning to play the hero, take a few potions with you. I prefer customers who stay alive... they tend to come back for more.
ysifur.status_restored: Your life and magic have been restored.

zodeu.dialog_1: Stone may seem simple, but it`s one of the most important materials there is. With the right tools, you can find much more than you might expect.
zodeu.dialog_2: Even during a festival, someone has to do the hard work. While everyone else is dancing, you could be finding something valuable hidden beneath your feet.
zodeu.dialog_3: Not all stone is the same. Some are common, while others may have properties that only reveal themselves when worked.
zodeu.dialog_4: The earth holds many secrets. The problem is that you usually have to break a few stones to discover them.
